feature: Add staleTime configuration to frequently-used SDK query hooks
workflow_rationale: This is a simple workflow because it's adding configuration to existing hooks within a single package. No multi-service coordination needed, no new features, just performance optimization through appropriate cache configuration. Each hook file can be updated independently without dependencies.

phases.name: Add staleTime to Booking Hooks
phases.description: Add appropriate staleTime configuration to booking-related query hooks

subtasks.description: Add staleTime to booking query hooks (useBookings, useBooking, useMyBookings, useRecurringBookings)

changes.useBookings: staleTime: 3 * 60 * 1000 // 3 minutes - booking lists change moderately
changes.useMyBookings: staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000 // 2 minutes - user's own bookings (more dynamic)
changes.useRecurringBookings: staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000 // 5 minutes - recurring patterns change less often

subtasks.notes: Added staleTime configuration to useBookings (2min), useBooking (2min), useMyBookings (2min), and useRecurringBookings (5min). All tests pass. Commit: 53758ee

subtasks.description: Add staleTime to calendar and availability hooks (useCalendarEvents, useAvailabilitySlots, useAllocations)

changes.useCalendarEvents: staleTime: 60 * 1000 // 1 minute - calendar needs fresher data

subtasks.notes: Added staleTime configuration to useCalendarEvents (2min), useAvailabilitySlots (1min), and useAllocations (5min). All tests pass. Commit: 1f863f4
